info.title: Strongbox
info.description:
Shared persistence for Dreamcatcher apps: personal state, team records, app-wide data and encrypted attachments.

* Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <OIDC ID token>`. A registered app client acting for a member also sends `X-On-Behalf-Of: <user token>`; access is the intersection of both principals.
* App data lives under `/v1/apps/{app}`. The deployment fixes the environment. Naming an app selects it; membership grants access. Resources are private to their owner unless shared with a team, the whole app, or by explicit grant.
* Every CUI response carries `X-Strongbox-Marking`; propagate it downstream.
* Mutations accept `Idempotency-Key`. A retry returns the original result (re-authorized); see `GET /v1/apps/{app}/operations/{op_id}`.
* Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Your role and teams in the app

put.summary: Add a member or change a role (app admin + apps:manage)

post.summary: Create a team; you become its admin

put.summary: Add a team member or change their team role

delete.summary: Remove a team member (anyone may leave)

post.summary: Upload a blob in one request (up to max_single_upload_bytes)

get.summary: List blobs visible to you, newest first

post.summary: Start an upload session for a blob larger than one request allows

201.description: Session created; the declared size is reserved against the app's quota

post.description: Send each part with PUT .../parts/{n}: exactly part_size bytes, the last part the remainder. Parts may be sent in any order and retried. Then POST .../complete.

get.summary: Session state, including which parts have arrived (to resume)

delete.summary: Abort a pending session; its parts are deleted by the worker

put.summary: Store one part (replaces an earlier copy of the same part)

post.summary: Activate the blob once every part is present with its exact size

get.summary: What the app stores against its quota

delete.summary: Delete (object removed by the worker); shred=true also destroys the wrapped data key

put.summary: Stage a new contract version (editor/admin role + collections:admin)

200.description: Took effect at once: every record valid before is provably valid now

202.description: Migration started; the collection switches when every live record passes

put.description: While a migration runs, writes must satisfy both contracts. Unique fields must be indexed; a unique violation (409 unique_violation) never names the record holding the value.

post.summary: Abandon a running migration; the collection keeps its version
Create a record (private unless visibility says otherwise)
Equality query on indexed fields, newest first
post.description: Records you may not see never count toward the page. A filter is an assertion about content, so filtered queries consider only records whose content you may read.

put.summary: Replace a record's data (compare-and-swap on If-Match)

delete.summary: Delete a record (history kept unless purge=true)

get.summary: A version's content (authorized against that version's marking)

post.summary: Undo: make an earlier version current as a new version

get.summary: Status of your own operation (after a lost response)

post.summary: Why a subject can or cannot act on a resource (app admin + apps:manage)

get.summary: One audit chain of the app (app admin + audit:read)
Verify every audit chain of the app (app admin + audit:read)

app.name: app
app.description: App identifier. The deployment fixes the environment; naming an app selects it and grants nothing.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor (bound to this app and listing)

before.name: before
before.description: Return versions below this one (from next_before)

afterSeq.name: after_seq
afterSeq.description: Return events after this sequence number

shred.name: shred
shred.description: Also destroy the wrapped data key

purge.name: purge
purge.description: Remove the record and its history

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client operation ID (8-128 chars). Retrying with the same ID returns the original result; reusing it for a different operation is 409.

OnBehalfOf.name: X-On-Behalf-Of
OnBehalfOf.description: User token when a registered app client acts for a member; access is the intersection of both.

Team.name: X-Strongbox-Team
Team.description: Team ID when visibility is team

Marking.description: CUI banner of the content; propagate it downstream

NotFound.description: Not found; also returned when access is denied, so existence cannot be probed

Conflict.description: Conflict (codes: conflict, idempotency_key_reused, operation_in_progress, upload_expired, upload_incomplete, unique_violation, migration_in_progress, migration_finished)

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match the current version

TooLarge.description: Request exceeds an advertised limit (see GET /v1/limits)

TooMany.description: Rate or concurrency limit; retry after Retry-After

Unavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable (database, KMS); retry after Retry-After

Quota.description: The app's storage quota is exhausted
